summary: Frontend-only testing of NCAA Recruiting Timeline feature completed successfully. All features are working correctly including tab system, division selector, current period banner, timeline bar visualization, key dates section with status tags, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: Calendar page tab system - 'My Calendar' and 'NCAA Timeline' tabs switch content correctly
NCAA Timeline renders current period banner with division label (D1/D2/D3/NAIA), period type (Contact), description, and days remaining badge (75 days remaining)
Division selector chips (D1/D2/D3/NAIA) switch the timeline data correctly
Visual timeline bar renders with color-coded segments (Contact=green, Dead=red, Evaluation=blue, Quiet=amber) and NOW marker
Key NCAA Dates section renders date cards with status tags - 'Passed' for NLI Early Signing Period, 'X days away' for upcoming dates
D3 shows year-round contact periods with info cards - 'No NLI for D3' and 'Coaches can contact year-round' with 'Info' status tags
NAIA shows year-round contact periods with info cards - 'NAIA Letter of Intent' and 'Coaches can contact year-round' with 'Info' status tags
My Calendar tab still shows the calendar grid and event functionality after switching back from NCAA Timeline
Mobile responsiveness (390px viewport) - All elements visible: tab bar, current period banner, division chips, timeline bar, key dates section
Dashboard offers count shows correctly with celebration card style (1 Offer Received with sparkles icon)
Recruiting Board cards show contextual alerts - 'Overdue since Feb 10', 'You haven't contacted the coach yet', 'Needs Attention' badges
test_credentials: No credentials needed - public app with mocked auth
